file_path.description: Path to the HWPX file to stamp.

specs.description:
Approved text specs: one per candidate from hwpforge_stamp_plan,
each with an action ({"field":{"name":"…"}} or "ignore"). Every
unguarded candidate must be covered (all-or-nothing).

cells.description:
Approved cell specs (class-B, from hwpforge_stamp_plan `cells`).
Field actions REQUIRE a non-blank hint; presence of any cell spec
requires `source_sha256`.

source_sha256.description:
SHA-256 of the input from hwpforge_stamp_plan — mandatory with
`cells` (drift pinning); selects the v2 pipeline when present.

output_path.description: Output HWPX file path. Must end with `.hwpx`.

StampSpec.description:
One approved candidate: identity (section/path/span/marker) + action.

Identity must match a live plan candidate exactly — a stale span or
edited document fails preflight instead of stamping the wrong text.

span.description: UTF-8 byte span within the slot text (from [`StampCandidate::span`]).

marker.description: Original marker text, verified against the document.

action.description: What to do with this candidate.

StampAction.description:
Caller decision for one candidate (design §3-3: the caller map is the
only source of final field names — no auto-derived names, no suffixes).

oneOf.description: Promote to a named ClickHere field.

name.description: Unique field name (unique across specs AND existing fields).

hint.description: Optional hint; defaults to the original marker text.

CellStampSpec.description: One approved class-B target: identity + drift claim + action.

table.description: Table ordinal in shared inventory (DFS pre-order) document order.

at.description:
Canonical anchor coordinate of the target cell (covered coordinates
are rejected at preflight, never silently resolved).

label.description: Label drift claim; `None` marks an explicit orphan target.

action.description: What to do with this target.

GridCoord.description: Absolute position on the pre-merge logical grid, zero-based.

CellLabelClaim.description:
Drift re-verification claim for a detected candidate's label.

Present on specs approving a detected candidate: preflight re-checks
that the label cell at `at` still normalize-matches `text`. Absent for
explicit (caller-authored) orphan targets.

at.description: Anchor coordinate of the label cell.

text.description: Label text as reported by plan (compared normalized).

CellStampAction.description:
Caller decision for one class-B cell target.

Unlike class-A [`StampAction`](super::StampAction), the `hint` is
**required**: a canonical
empty cell carries no marker text, so the unfilled field body must come
from the caller (see module docs).

oneOf.description: Promote the cell content to a named ClickHere field.

name.description:
Unique field name (unique across text+cell specs AND existing
fields).

hint.description: Unfilled field body and hint (must not be blank).
